COMICCHESS-STRIKE_QUEEN.title: Strike
COMICCHESS-DEFEND_QUEEN.title: Defend
COMICCHESS-SUMMON_SOUL.title: Soul Gathering
COMICCHESS-SUMMON_SOUL.description:
Create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul Strike+|Soul Strike}[/gold] and a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul Defend+|Soul Defend}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-SOUL_STRIKE.title: Soul Strike
COMICCHESS-SOUL_DEFEND.title: Soul Defend
COMICCHESS-DEVOUR.title: Devour
COMICCHESS-DEVOUR.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.{IfUpgraded:show:
Target loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.|}
COMICCHESS-GAZE.title: Gaze
COMICCHESS-GAZE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Corrode this card into [purple]Bound[/purple].
COMICCHESS-GEM_SHIELD.title: Gem Shield
COMICCHESS-GEM_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}{IfUpgraded:show: and [aqua]1 Soul Lamp[/aqua]|}.
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.title: Gem Charge
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.description:
Create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Piercing Charge+|Piercing Charge}[/gold] and a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Diffuse Charge+|Diffuse Charge}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-PIERCING_CHARGE.title: Piercing Charge
COMICCHESS-DIFFUSE_CHARGE.title: Diffuse Charge
COMICCHESS-MYSTIC_CHANT.title: Mystic Chant
COMICCHESS-MYSTIC_CHANT.description:
Create [gold]First Chant[/gold], [gold]Second Chant[/gold], and [gold]Final Chant[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]|}
COMICCHESS-FIRST_CHANT.title: First Chant
COMICCHESS-FIRST_CHANT.description: Give [gold]Second Chant[/gold] in your hand [blue]1[/blue] stack of [gold]Replay[/gold]. Return this card to your hand.
COMICCHESS-SECOND_CHANT.title: Second Chant
COMICCHESS-SECOND_CHANT.description: Increase [gold]Final Chant[/gold]'s hit count in your hand by [blue]1[/blue]. Return this card to your hand.
COMICCHESS-FINAL_CHANT.title: Final Chant
COMICCHESS-FINAL_CHANT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies{Repeat:choose(1):|
[blue]{Repeat}[/blue] times}.
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN.title: Awaken
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN.description:
Create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Awaken Fear+|Awaken Fear}[/gold] and a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Awaken Pain+|Awaken Pain}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN_FEAR.title: Awaken Fear
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN_PAIN.title: Awaken Pain
COMICCHESS-PEEP.title: Peep
COMICCHESS-SCRATCH.title: Scratch
COMICCHESS-SCRATCH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage{Repeat:choose(1):| {} times}.
All cards with [gold]Scratch[/gold] in their name deal {IncreaseDamage:diff()} more damage.
COMICCHESS-ENDLESS_SCRATCH.title: Endless Scratch
COMICCHESS-ENDLESS_SCRATCH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage{Repeat:choose(1):| {} times}.
This combat, all cards with [gold]Scratch[/gold] gain [blue]+1[/blue] hit count.
COMICCHESS-PLAY_WITH.title: Play With
COMICCHESS-PLAY_WITH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]hand[/gold].
COMICCHESS-PLAY_WITH.selectionPrompt: Choose 1 card in your hand to add [gold]Retain[/gold].
COMICCHESS-DARK_VEIL.title: Dark Veil
COMICCHESS-DARK_VEIL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have no [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold], gain {BonusBlock} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.title: Bind
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.description: Corrode 1 card in your hand into [purple]Bound[/purple].
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.selectionPrompt: Choose 1 card in your hand to corrode into [purple]Bound[/purple].
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON.title: Chains Prison
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. When you gain [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold], the target takes {SoulLampDamage:diff()} damage.
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD.title: Soul Mold
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD.description: The first time you play a Skill each turn, add a [gold]Fade[/gold] copy of it to your hand and corrode it into [purple]Bound[/purple].
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL.title: Ashen Wall
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL.description: Whenever you exhaust a card with [gold]Fade[/gold], gain {BlockOnFadeExhaust:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-GEM_WHIRL.title: Gem Whirl
COMICCHESS-GEM_WHIRL.description: Draw {Draw:diff()} cards. The first time you gain [aqua]Soul Lamp[/aqua] each turn, return this card from your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold] to your [gold]hand[/gold].
COMICCHESS-ALL_SOUL_SLASH.title: All-Soul Slash
COMICCHESS-ALL_SOUL_SLASH.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each card with [gold]Fade[/gold] in your Exhaust pile, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
COMICCHESS-SALVAGE.title: Salvage
COMICCHESS-SALVAGE.description: This card can only be played if you have no [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold]. Draw {Draw:diff()} cards.
COMICCHESS-REMINISCE.title: Reminisce
COMICCHESS-REMINISCE.description:
Choose {Pick:diff()} [purple]Bound[/purple] cards from your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold] and return them to your hand.
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-STRONG_ADAPTABILITY.title: Strong Adaptability
COMICCHESS-STRONG_ADAPTABILITY.descripti: At the start of your turn, choose a card in your hand to upgrade.
COMICCHESS-TASTE.title: Taste
COMICCHESS-TASTE.description:
Choose [blue]2[/blue] cards in your hand and turn them into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Devour+|Devour}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 2 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-TASTE.selectionPrompt: Choose 2 cards in your hand to turn into Devour.
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL.title: Willful
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL.description: At the start of your turn, if Soul Lamp stacks {IfUpgraded:show:are at most [blue]3[/blue]|are [blue]0[/blue]}, [aqua]gain 1 Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-YOU_ARE_MINE.title: You're Mine!
COMICCHESS-YOU_ARE_MINE.description: {Hits:diff()} times in a row, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] or [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy.
COMICCHESS-PURIFICATION_RITE.title: Purification Rite
COMICCHESS-FIRE_WALL.title: Fire Wall
COMICCHESS-HUNDRED_HANDS_BANQUET.title: Banquet of Hundred Hands
COMICCHESS-HUNDRED_HANDS_BANQUET.descrip:
Lose X HP. Create X [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Bloodthirst Scratch+|Bloodthirst Scratch}[/gold].
Gain X [aqua]Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-BLOODTHIRST_SCRATCH.title: Bloodthirst Scratch
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_SEIZURE.title: Hand of Seizure
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_SEIZURE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Next turn, create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Refusal+|Hand of Refusal}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_REFUSAL.title: Hand of Refusal
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_REFUSAL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Seizure+|Hand of Seizure}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-HUNGER.title: Hunger
COMICCHESS-HUNGER.description:
Create [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Devour+|Devour}[/gold].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
Whenever you play [gold]Devour[/gold], [aqua]gain 1 Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-FEEDING.title: Feeding
COMICCHESS-JOYLESS.title: ...Joyless
COMICCHESS-JOYLESS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage{Repeat:choose(1):| {} times}.
Discard any number of cards from your hand.
For each card discarded, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
COMICCHESS-JOYLESS.selectionPrompt: Choose any number of cards in your hand to discard.
COMICCHESS-MIND_YOUR_MANNERS.title: Mind Your Manners!
COMICCHESS-MIND_YOUR_MANNERS.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Transfer your [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] to the target.
COMICCHESS-RUINOUS_ART.title: Ruinous Art
COMICCHESS-RUINOUS_ART.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this card consumed {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, damage becomes [blue]3[/blue]x.
COMICCHESS-OPPRESSIVE_PRESENCE.title: Oppressive Presence
COMICCHESS-OPPRESSIVE_PRESENCE.descripti: Automatically play all [gold]Devour[/gold] in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to random enemies [blue]{Hits}[/blue] times.
COMICCHESS-PRISMATIC_ART.title: Prismatic Art
COMICCHESS-PRISMATIC_ART.description: At end of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] extra [gold]card[/gold] reward group containing other colors.
COMICCHESS-MAGIC_TIME.title: Magic Time
COMICCHESS-MAGIC_TIME.description:
Corrode all your cards into [purple]Bound[/purple].
At the start of your turn, if Soul Lamp is [blue]0[/blue], lose [gold]1[/gold] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and [aqua]gain [blue]1[/blue] Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-GRANT_OFFENSE.title: Grant Offense
COMICCHESS-GRANT_OFFENSE.description:
Summon {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn[/gold]: At the end of your turn, the Amalgam deals {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
COMICCHESS-BURN_BRIGHT_FOR_ME.title: Burn Bright For Me
COMICCHESS-RENOUNCE_INTENT.title: Renounce
COMICCHESS-RENOUNCE_INTENT.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] immediately acts once, then forgets that intent. {IfUpgraded:show:|
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].}
COMICCHESS-SOUL_LOCK_CASKET.title: Soul Lock Casket
COMICCHESS-SOUL_LOCK_CASKET.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold] on non-[gold]Boss[/gold] enemies [gold]Captures[/gold] the target.
COMICCHESS-FRAIL_SPORES.title: Frail Spores
